name: SUNVIEW
recent: Sunview 正在分阶段出售其在 Winstar Capital Berhad 的 22.44% 股权，总代价约 RM30.1 million，截至 2026 年 11 月 18 日已完成部分批次。公司同时就 Labuan 太阳能项目寻求法院批准追讨欠款，并有一项收购 JSNT 的交易截止日已延至 2027 年。此外，公司于 9 月完成第六批也是最后一批私募配售。
notable: 公司分阶段出售 Winstar Capital Berhad 22.44% 股权，总现金代价约 RM30.1 million。
公司就 Labuan 太阳能项目向法院申请追讨欠款。
公司获得 RM5 million 银行融资。
risks: 公司此前进行私募配售，最多发行 10% 新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
公司有一项重大诉讼，涉及追讨 Labuan 太阳能项目欠款。
收购 JSNT 的条件先决期限已多次延长，最新截止日为 2027 年 3 月 31 日。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收为 RM104.8 million，环比增长 65.7%，同比增长 62.7%；净利为 RM95,000，环比下降 6.9%，同比下降 93.2%，净利率为 0.1%。

recent_en: Sunview is disposing of its 22.44% stake in Winstar Capital Berhad for approximately RM30.1 million in tranches, with partial completions as of 18 November 2026. The company is also seeking court approval to recover sums owed from a Labuan solar project, and the completion deadline for its JSNT acquisition has been extended to 2027. Additionally, the company completed the sixth and final tranche of its private placement in September.
notable_en: The company is disposing of a 22.44% stake in Winstar Capital Berhad for total cash consideration of approximately RM30.1 million in tranches.
The company is seeking court approval to recover sums owed from a Labuan solar project.
The company secured a RM5 million banking facility.
risks_en: The company conducted a private placement of up to 10% new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.
The company is involved in material litigation related to recovering sums owed from a Labuan solar project.
The conditions precedent deadline for the JSNT acquisition has been extended multiple times, with the latest deadline on 31 March 2027.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM104.8 million, up 65.7% QoQ and 62.7% YoY; net income was RM95,000, down 6.9% QoQ and 93.2% YoY, with a net margin of 0.1%.
